front_content.text:
If she were here now, she could explain the problem.
If she had been here yesterday, she could have explained the problem.

两句分别设想什么时间？从哪里看出来？
front_content.task_prompt:

back_content.text: 第一句设想她现在在场；第二句设想她昨天在场。

front_content.text:

任务：这句设想的是现在还是过去？

back_content.text: B。设想的是过去：没有你的帮助，我们当时就无法按时完成。

front_content.text:
If only the researchers had recognized the flaw earlier, the entire experiment could have been salvaged.

任务：作者在遗憾什么？

back_content.text: B。遗憾没有更早发现缺陷；若早发现，实验本可能得到挽救。
back_content.explanation: If only...had recognized 表示希望过去早点发现，可现实未做到。could have been salvaged 表示那样本有挽救的可能，could 不等于一定能成功。

analysis_content.text: If only...had recognized 表示希望过去早点发现，可现实未做到。could have been salvaged 表示那样本有挽救的可能，could 不等于一定能成功。
tips: 把 If only 读成“要是当时……就好了”。

front_content.text:
The author implies that had the government intervened sooner, thousands of jobs could have been saved.

任务：作者对干预时机有什么看法？
front_content.task_prompt: 作者对干预时机有什么看法？

back_content.text: B。作者认为干预不够早，更早行动本可能保住数千个岗位。
back_content.explanation: had the government intervened sooner 是省去 if 的倒装，等于 If the government had intervened sooner。could have been saved 设想更早干预可能带来的过去结果，表达遗憾或批评。

analysis_content.text: had the government intervened sooner 是省去 if 的倒装，等于 If the government had intervened sooner。could have been saved 设想更早干预可能带来的过去结果，表达遗憾或批评。
tips: 先把 Had the government... 还原成 If the government had...。
